blind_spots_patched: Baseline ch-1 and ch-6 omitted the September 2026 boardroom governance rupture (resignations of Chairman O.P. Bhatt and NRC Chair D.K. Singh following a KPMG board-evaluation audit) and under-analyzed the ~21.8% PE sponsor rollover block (Advent International & Warburg Pincus, two Advent board seats).

Baseline ch-3, ch-5, and ch-6 cited FY26 annual debtor days of 88 days but missed that Q2 FY27 Total DSO surged +8 days QoQ to 110 days with net unbilled revenue climbing from ₹2,100 Cr to ₹2,600 Cr during Encora US-to-India legal-entity contract migration, alongside flat QoQ Encora standalone revenue (~$147–148M).

Baseline ch-3 and ch-6 left negative Other Income (-₹218 Cr TTM) unexplained beyond generic FX items and omitted both the specific $10.2M Q2 FY27 FX hedge-loss runoff schedule and US H-1B visa fee policy exposure ($100k new visa fee).
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Following BPEA EQT's August 2023 full exit, Coforge operates as a friction-free, widely held institution with zero promoter overhang.
WEAKENED: FY26 Screener Debtor Days stretched to 88 days and are expected to revert toward <=80 days post-Encora.

CONFIRMED: Coforge's Q2 FY27 operating momentum ($2.38B 12-month executable order book, $1.04B TCV, 16.0% EBIT margin, FY27 EBIT margin guidance raised to 16.0%) and AI-led delivery expansion remain intact.
CONFIRMED: Post-Encora borrowings of ₹6,026 Cr (including the $550M 3-year term loan at 4.6% fixed) are serviceable with ~11.3x Q2 FY27 EBITDA/interest coverage.
